population: Accounts of resident private-sector individuals in foreign-currency savings and time deposits
method: For each instrument, account counts and reported balance values were summed across BCRA strata. Balance concentration uses shares, so the workbook's peso valuation of balances cancels out.
threshold_interpretation: Foreign-currency deposit strata are used as a proxy for dollar-account size; the statistical table aggregates foreign currencies and does not identify unique people.
caveats: An account is not a person; the same person can own multiple accounts or both instruments.
The table only covers deposits inside financial institutions and cannot measure cash outside the system.
The very large base includes zero and low-balance savings accounts, so the account share is not a household prevalence rate.
The combined row adds account-instruments and must not be read as a count of unique savers.
Published time-deposit buckets differ from the reported total by 0.061%, matching the workbook's statistical-discrepancy field. Shares use the reported total as denominator.
